chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Hassan, from Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'The best of your dates is the Barni variety; feed it to the women during their postpartum period, so that your children may be wise.'

key_terms.الْبَرْنِيُّ: the Barni variety (a specific type of date known for quality)
key_terms.حُكَمَاءَ: wise (plural of hakim, indicating wisdom or prudence)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended date variety for postpartum women according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration, transmitted through the chain of Zurarah to Imam al-Sadiq, attributes a specific dietary recommendation to Imam Ali regarding the Barni date variety, linking maternal nutrition during postpartum recovery to the intellectual development of offspring. In Shia scholarly tradition, this highlights the integration of physical health (tibb) with spiritual and intellectual well-being, emphasizing that proper nourishment during the critical postpartum period contributes to the child's future wisdom (hukm).
